value: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) milling rice; (2) cleaning and polishing rice; or (3) milling, cleaning, and polishing rice. The establishments in this industry may package the rice they mill with other ingredients.
Bran and other residues of milling rice
Rice bran, flour, and meals, manufacturing
Rice mixes (i.e., uncooked and packaged with other ingredients) made in rice mills
